description: Acterys Matrix is a feature-rich custom Power BI visual for planning that empowers finance and operations teams with robust budgeting and forecasting in Power BI. Unlike standard visuals, it provides advanced data entry, allocation, and write-back capabilities, allowing teams to manage detailed financial plans directly inside their Power BI reports. Designed to connect seamlessly with ERP and SaaS platforms like Dynamics, SAP, and Xero, Acterys Matrix simplifies and automates financial planning in Power BI, ensuring your reporting and forecasting workflows stay dynamic, accurate, and actionable. From flexible data input to dynamic cell locking and real-time validation, Acterys Matrix is the ultimate Power BI matrix visual for enterprise-grade planning. Key Features: Top-Down / Bottom-Up Data Entry: Input values at any matrix level, with automated distribution across detail rows. Flexible Data Entry Options: Apply custom allocations, fill across periods, or distribute values evenly using the visual’s in-visual data entry in Power BI. Conditional Formatting: Highlight key values, outliers, or trends using rules tailored to your business metrics. Comment Markers: Annotate key inputs with contextual notes to improve auditability and clarity.
